objective: Build KU2D Core Intelligence v1 as a deterministic, knowledge-guided recommendation and explanation layer over the merged Core Knowledge foundation, without ML execution or acquisition-scope expansion.
instructions: BRANCH HANDOFF IS MANDATORY: if the current checkout is not codex/ku2d-core-intelligence-v1, switch to codex/ku2d-core-intelligence-v1 first, fetch/pull the latest remote state, then read queue.json from that branch. Do not continue from codex/ku2d-core-knowledge-backfill-v1 or any stale branch.
Confirm the branch starts from merged Core Knowledge commit 7f0e7d72517754dcd0e90e5243cabf56120cc224 and includes KU2D-H-000002 plus this prompt before implementation.

Inspect the merged Core Knowledge taxonomy, Reviewed Learning Corpus, Candidate Learning Evidence Registry, Core Coverage Matrix, Knowledge Gap Register, ML Knowledge Map, Acquisition Learning Memory, Human-confirmed semantic policies, source registries, domain playbooks, execution-environment profiles, purposes, targets, and existing orchestration contracts before editing.
Create a generic storage-neutral KU2D Core Intelligence contract/module. It must consume structured source/context facts and reviewed knowledge; it must not perform live acquisition itself.

At minimum support deterministic assessments for: source characteristic classification, candidate acquisition-technique ranking, execution-environment suitability, evidence-strength assessment, uncertainty/review requirement, relevant knowledge gaps, and explanation/provenance references.

Recommendation output must distinguish: observed fact, reviewed rule/policy, deterministic inference, candidate-only clue, unresolved uncertainty, and human-confirmed semantic policy. Never collapse these into one confidence number without provenance.

Use only Reviewed Learning Corpus and human-confirmed policy chains as authority for validated recommendations. Candidate Learning Evidence may be shown as a clue or pending evidence but must never upgrade validation state, Ground Truth, production approval, or ML eligibility.

Implement an explainable Recommendation Trace so every recommendation can answer: which inputs were observed, which reviewed episodes/policies were used, which rule fired, what alternatives were considered, what uncertainty remains, and whether Human Review is required.

Add a deterministic Core Intelligence Scenario/fixture suite using already reviewed historical patterns only. Include at least: sitemap-to-canonical-detail, rendered DOM/browser, app-bundle discovery, cloud-vs-Edge environment boundary, application-shell/traffic-verification negative boundary, explicit official API/metadata, and an unresolved case where the system must return review_required rather than force a recommendation.

Add a coverage-aware next-exploration advisory that ranks missing capability/pattern gaps from the Knowledge Gap Register and explains why a future exploration would be valuable. It must recommend a pattern/capability to test, not launch a brand/source exploration and not make live requests.

Preserve the separation Learning Memory -> Reviewed Learning Corpus -> future task-specific ML Training Dataset. Do not create/export a training dataset, train a model, run inference, add embeddings/vector storage, or auto-label new source outcomes.
Do not add Survey/Google Forms/DoE/Bias/SEM, connected-system connectors, new domains, new marketplaces, production scheduling, or UI redesign in this PR.
No runtime auto-write from normal acquisition flows. Core Intelligence may be invoked explicitly in deterministic tests or future review tooling only unless separately approved.

Add fail-closed validation for contradictory input facts, unsupported taxonomy IDs, missing provenance, candidate-only evidence masquerading as reviewed authority, fabricated human authority, and production/scheduler side effects.

Add deterministic self-tests covering at least: reviewed-pattern recommendation, candidate-only non-promotion, environment-vs-technique distinction, evidence-vs-interpretation distinction, product-vs-variant distinction, display-order-vs-demand policy, price temporal-status-vs-role policy, negative boundary handling, unresolved review_required behavior, recommendation trace completeness, gap advisory pattern-not-brand behavior, sensitive-material rejection, no live requests, no production authorization, no ML execution/export, and no automatic runtime write.

Run git diff --check, JSON/YAML parsing, Python compilation, Core Knowledge tests, Learning Memory tests, Agent Handoff tests, the complete deterministic Data Acquisition corpus, and relevant supermarket/retail/YouTube/Shopee/Lazada/JIB/lifecycle regressions.
Open a new Draft PR targeting integration/data-acquisition-platform titled 'KU2D: Add Core Intelligence v1'. Keep the PR bounded to the deterministic intelligence layer and tests/docs.

Write KU2D-R-000008 with branch, exact commit SHAs, Draft PR number, files changed, intelligence contracts, recommendation behavior, trace behavior, scenario coverage, gap advisory behavior, tests/CI/security/live-request count, production state, and remaining blockers. Then hand control to assistant.
